event_summary: A blue upright rectangular prism on a round base remains in place while its visible faces and wall shadow gradually change over time.
raw_event_description: The scene shows a small blue rectangular prism standing upright on a circular base on a tabletop, with a bright circular light area on the wall behind it. Throughout the video, the prism stays upright and near the same image position, but the visible cyan and darker side faces shift gradually. A dark vertical shadow and adjoining horizontal shadow on the wall also remain visible and gradually change in shape and position relative to the lit wall area.

reasons: The upright blue prism, circular base, tabletop, wall, illuminated wall area, and wall shadow are all visible at the start.
The visible change appears to be already in progress from the first frame.
